name: smwgraphics-numbered-platforms
title: Numbered Platforms
description:
I'm here with the numbered platforms released at the Winter 2022 C3.
The numbered clown platforms has a sample level with its animations.
All platforms have their own custom palette.
These work with MarioFanGamer's Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Numbered Platforms.
The DKC2 version took a lot to draw, as I had to examine styles.
Give credit, if used.
